observations.row_balance: Both images: the row looks balanced — Cancel and Edit are compact text-weight controls while 送る (amber pill) is clearly the heaviest/widest, matching its importance as the primary action. No control looks obviously under- or over-weighted in either image.
observations.content_lost: 8F41 has a \">\" chevron after the \"出所 週次同期・田中・10:42\" line that is MISSING in C29D. No other text or element differs between the two images.

why.primary_action_salience: 送る is the same amber, same size, and same position relative to Cancel/Edit in both images, so salience is identical.
why.error_prevention: Button sizes, spacing, and order (Cancel / Edit / 送る) are identical between the two, so accidental-tap risk is the same.
why.control_visibility: All three controls are equally visible and legible in both images with no visual difference in the button row itself.
why.visual_craft: 8F41 adds a \">\" affordance on the source line, signaling the line is expandable/tappable for more detail — a small but purposeful craft touch that C29D lacks.
why.overall: The two are near-identical except for the missing chevron in C29D; that's too minor on its own to call a clear overall winner.
